classification.rationale: A bib apron is a garment of heading 6211, and being unisex it is treated as women's under chapter 62 note 9. NY G83072 (in force) classified a woven cotton bib apron as a women's other garment of cotton (then 6211.42.0081, category 359). In the current tree that falls in 6211.42.10 and the residual statistical line 6211.42.10.92, since the apron is not hospital or laboratory apparel.
